reference.$: end of line (2$ = end of next line)
reference.gg: first line, or line N with Ngg
reference.G: last line, or line N with NG

lessons.title: Step 1: Left and Right
lessons.description: Start with h and l so horizontal movement feels automatic.

lessons.title: Step 2: Up and Down
lessons.description: Add j and k to move between lines while keeping your column.

lessons.title: Step 3: Next Word
lessons.description: Use w to stop crawling and start thinking in words.

lessons.title: Step 4: Previous Word
lessons.description: Learn b so you can reposition without falling back to arrows.

lessons.title: Step 5: Word Ends
lessons.description: Add e to land exactly where edits often begin.

lessons.title: Step 6: Line Edges
lessons.description: Use 0 and $ to snap to the start or end of a line.

lessons.title: Step 7: Counts
lessons.description: Bundle repeated motions into one command for speed.

lessons.title: Step 8: Big Jumps
lessons.description: Finish with gg and G so you can navigate whole files.

single_lines: focus on one motion at a time
fingers rest on the home row
sprint_snippets: the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
pack my box with five dozen liquor jugs
how vexingly quick daft zebras jump
sphinx of black quartz, judge my vow
calm motions build lasting muscle memory

steps.task: Fix the page title: land on `My`.
steps.why: Then `cit` changes everything inside the tag.

steps.task: Change the link target: land on `about` in the href.
steps.why: Then `ci"` swaps the whole URL.

steps.task: Rename the link's class: land on `nav`.
steps.why: Then `ciw` and the new class name.

steps.task: Change the document language: land on `en`.
steps.why: Then `ciw` fr.

steps.task: Jump to `html` in the closing tag.
steps.why: Then `gg=G` would re-indent the whole page.

steps.task: The port is wrong. Jump to 3000.
steps.why: Then `ciw` 8080 - or 5080 Ctrl-A to add to it.

steps.task: Turn debugging on: land on `false`.
steps.why: Then `ciw` true.

steps.task: Change the host: land on `localhost`.
steps.why: Then `ci"` replaces everything inside the quotes.

steps.task: Rename the export: land on `config` on the last line.
steps.why: Then `ciw` - press * first to find every use.

steps.task: Point it at another endpoint: land on `users`.
steps.why: Then `ciw` and the new resource name.

steps.task: Improve the error: land on `load` in the message.
steps.why: Then `ci"` rewrites the whole string.

steps.task: Land on the function name `loadUser`.
steps.why: Then `*` jumps to its next use.

steps.task: Land on `json` in the return line.
steps.why: Then `ciw` text if the API returns plain text.

steps.task: Tighten the padding: land on 24px.
steps.why: Then `ciw` - 24px is one word, digits and unit together.

steps.task: Change the colour: land on the # of #333.
steps.why: Then `cW` replaces the whole value, # included.

steps.task: Switch the layout: land on `flex`.
steps.why: Then `ciw` grid.

steps.task: Soften the shadow: land on 0.2.
steps.why: Then `cW` replaces 0.2 in one go.

steps.task: A NameError points at the last line - jump there.
steps.why: G lands on the first non-blank, ready to read the line.

steps.task: Land on the misspelt `value` inside len().
steps.why: Then `ea` would append the missing s.

steps.task: Check the closing paren at the end of the line.
steps.why: Then `i` lets you type just before the paren.

steps.task: Back to the top: land on the function name.
steps.why: Then `ciw` would rename it.

steps.task: Now the loop variable `v` on line 3.
steps.why: Then `*` would highlight every use of v.

steps.task: Raise the default timeout: land on the 5.
steps.why: Then `r9` replaces that one character.

steps.task: Land on `raise_for_status`.
steps.why: Underscores are word characters, so w treats it as one word.

steps.task: Land on `get` in requests.get.
steps.why: The . is its own word - count it when you use w.

steps.task: Go to the import on the first line.
steps.why: Then `o` opens a new line below for another import.

steps.task: Make the greeting friendlier: land on `Hello`.
steps.why: Then `ci"` rewrites the string.

steps.task: This field should be mutable: land on `final`.
steps.why: Then `dw` deletes the word and the space after it.

steps.task: Rename the method: land on `greet`.
steps.why: Then `ciw` - and remember to update its callers.

steps.task: Go to the class name on line 1.
steps.why: Then `ciw` renames the class - and the file name must match!

steps.task: Replace the magic number: land on 400.
steps.why: Then `ciw` http.StatusBadRequest.

steps.task: Improve the error text: land on `missing`.
steps.why: Then `ci"` rewrites the whole message.

steps.task: Rename the handler: land on `handle`.
steps.why: Then `ciw` - punctuation like ( is its own word for w.

steps.task: Check the greeting: land on `hello`.
steps.why: Then `ci"` changes the greeting text.

steps.task: Go to the closing brace at the very end.
steps.why: Then `o` opens a new line below for the next function.

steps.task: Off by one? Land on the loop bound 10.
steps.why: Then `ciw` 11 - or Ctrl-A to increment it.

steps.task: Land on `stdio` in the include.
steps.why: < is punctuation, so it counts as its own word for w.

steps.task: Change the format: land on `total` inside the quotes.
steps.why: Then `ci"` rewrites the whole format string.

steps.task: Land on the 0 in `return 0`.
steps.why: Then `r1` makes it return an error code.

steps.task: Find the TODO and land on it.
steps.why: Then `cc` replaces the whole comment line.

steps.task: Land on `split`, the function name.
steps.why: Then `ciw` to rename it.

steps.task: Land on `out` in the return line.
steps.why: Then `*` highlights every use.

steps.task: Back to the first include: land on `vector`.
steps.why: # and < are punctuation, so each run of them is a word for w.

steps.task: Change the default name: land on `world`.
steps.why: Then `ciw` and the new default.

steps.task: Loop more times: land on the 3.
steps.why: Then `a 4 5` appends more values after it.

steps.task: Land on `echo` to swap it for printf.
steps.why: Then `cw` printf.

steps.task: Check the shell options: land on the end of `pipefail`.
steps.why: Then `a` appends another option after pipefail.

steps.task: Scale up: land on the replica count.
steps.why: Then `4` Ctrl-A bumps it from 2 to 6.

steps.task: Bump the image tag: land on 1.25.
steps.why: Then `cW` swaps the whole tag in one go.

steps.task: Rename the app: land on `web`.
steps.why: Then `ciw` and the new name.

steps.task: Check the kind: land on the end of `Deployment`.
steps.why: Then `ciw` StatefulSet if it needs stable storage.

steps.task: Bump the minor version: land on the 2 in 1.2.0.
steps.why: Then `r3` makes it 1.3.0.

steps.task: Make the tests verbose: land on the q in -q.
steps.why: Then `rv` turns -q into -v.

steps.task: Publish it: land on `true`.
steps.why: Then `ciw` false.

steps.task: Rename the package: land on `vimgame`.
steps.why: Then `ci"` replaces the whole name.

steps.task: Change the entry point: land on `main`.
steps.why: Then `ciw` app - the .py stays put.
